## Contribution Overview

What kind of change is this? (Check all that apply)
- [ ] New model result for an existing benchmark
- [ ] New benchmark category
- [ ] UI/UX improvement to the gallery
- [ ] Bug fix

### Description

Please describe the changes you are proposing. 
- If adding a new model: Which model is it? What prompt was used?
- If adding a new benchmark: Briefly describe the game/ui it creates.

### Checklist

- [ ] I've run `bash create_config.sh` and it completed successfully.
- [ ] `config.json` is updated with my changes.
- [ ] My code (generated HTML) is self-contained.
- [ ] I have tested the changes locally in my browser.
